title: Torus knot tube with parallel-transport frames
purpose: Sweep a circle along a (p, q) torus knot with parallel-transport frames closed by an even twist, so the closed tube has no twist seam. Use it for knot sculpture, jewellery and decorative pipes.

entry_points.name: knot_point
entry_points.summary: Curve point at parameter t in [0, 2 pi): ((R + r cos qt) cos pt, r sin qt, -(R + r cos qt) sin pt).

entry_points.name: knot_tangent
entry_points.summary: Unit tangent of the curve from its analytic derivative.

entry_points.name: transport_frames
entry_points.summary: Normals carried around a closed curve by rotating each one with the turn between consecutive tangents, then corrected by an even twist so the last normal meets the first.

entry_points.name: torus_knot
entry_points.signature: torus_knot(p=2, q=3, major_radius=1.0, minor_radius=0.4, tube_radius=0.1, segments=180, sides=12)
entry_points.summary: A closed tube along the (p, q) torus knot: segments * sides vertices and quads, torus topology.

entry_points.name: main
entry_points.summary: Command line: write the knot tube as .gltf or .obj and print a JSON summary.

parameters.name: p
parameters.meaning: Turns around the Y axis (the torus' axis of symmetry).

parameters.name: q
parameters.meaning: Turns around the torus tube; p and q without a common factor give a knot.

parameters.name: major_radius
parameters.meaning: Radius of the torus the curve winds on.

parameters.name: minor_radius
parameters.meaning: Tube radius of that torus (how far the curve swings).

parameters.name: tube_radius
parameters.meaning: Radius of the swept circle; keep it below half the closest approach of the strands.

outputs.content: one welded mesh with POSITION and NORMAL, indexed triangles
the same tube as Wavefront OBJ

limits: The tube does not test for self-intersection: keep tube_radius below half the closest approach of the strands (true for the defaults). No texture coordinates. The volume and area checks compare with cross-section times curve length within 0.4 percent.
technique_references: Torus knot curve ((R + r cos qt) cos pt, r sin qt, -(R + r cos qt) sin pt)
Discrete parallel transport of frames (rotation between consecutive tangents)
Holonomy correction spread evenly along a closed curve
